statements.text: Companies interested in importing machinery from China for domestic manufacturing still have the opportunity to submit an exclusion request by March 31, 2025.
Any exclusion will be effective starting from the date of publication of the exclusion determination in the Federal Register and will extend through May 31, 2025.
the docket for submitting exclusions opens on October 15, 2024. The deadline for submitting exclusion requests is March 31, 2025.
Any exclusion will be effective starting from the date of publication of the exclusion determination in the Federal Register and will extend through May 31, 2025.

Consistent with the President’s direction, the exclusion process covers particular machinery used in domestic manufacturing classified within a subheading under chapters 84 and 85 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States.
The Section 301 exclusion process gives U.S. companies an opportunity to import machinery used in domestic manufacturing from China free of Section 301 duties.

The President also directed the U.S. Trade Representative to establish a process by which interested persons may request that particular machinery used in domestic manufacturing classified within a subheading under chapters 84 and 85 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) be temporarily excluded from Section 301 tariffs
USTR is accepting exclusion requests on a rolling basis and will periodically announce decisions on pending requests.
Exclusions granted will be effective upon publication in the Federal Register and valid through May 31, 2025.
